subject: [PATCH v2 1/5] btrfs: use an on-stack path in btrfs_insert_orphan_item()

reviews.author: Qu Wenruo
reviews.summary: Approved the patch with a Reviewed-by tag, indicating that it meets code quality standards and is ready for merge.

2026-08-05.patch_summary: This patch series modifies the btrfs_insert_orphan_item() function to allocate a path on the stack instead of dynamically, reducing the risk of transaction aborts due to memory allocation failures.
